d:
Market men nahin milega aisa chatapta namkin! poha makhana murmura
Chatpata Namkeen Recipe – Poonam Devnani ke saath Masala Kitchen par. Kam tel, poora swad. Diwali, travel aur tiffin ke liye
Chatpata namkeen: poha, murmura, makhana, peanuts, dry fruits
Kam tel ka balance: poha aur peanuts fry, baaki dry roast ya thode tel mein
Masala chipakne ki trick: haldi aur bhune saunf-jeera-rai ka masala
Comment karein – aap namkeen mein aur kya daalte hain?
